note: Executor registry for the typesafe-dispatch pipeline. ts_feasible hard-checks requires.env (process.env or typesafe-mcp/.env) and requires.command (PATH lookup). data_class = the most sensitive data class this executor may touch (trust routing, doc §IX): open(0) < standard(1) < restricted(2); a task whose data_class is X may only run on executors with clearance >= X. Unknown executor data_class is treated as open (safest). Keep <8 entries.
pseudo_entry_doc: NOT an executor: every TS Choice question (especially the executor question) must ALWAYS include an 'other' option as the no-match escape.
